changes: new category group attorney_fee_dispute: attorney_fee_dispute_yes_ind ('Check if your claim is about a client-fee dispute'), attorney_fee_dispute_no_ind ('Check if your claim is not about a client-fee dispute')
new category group suing_public_entity: suing_public_entity_yes_ind ('Check if you are suing a public entity'), suing_public_entity_no_ind ('Check if you are not suing a public entity')

new category group filed_more_than_12_claims: filed_more_than_12_claims_yes_ind ('Check if you have filed more than 12 other small claims in the last 12 months in California'), filed_more_than_12_claims_no_ind ('Check if you have not filed more than 12 other small claims in the last 12 months in California')
new category group claim_over_2500: claim_over_2500_yes_ind ('Check if your claim is for more than $2,500.'), claim_over_2500_no_ind ('Check if your claim is not for more than $2,500.')

8 field(s) removed, their boxes now options of a group: attorney_fee_dispute_no_ind, attorney_fee_dispute_yes_ind, claim_over_2500_no_ind, claim_over_2500_yes_ind, filed_more_than_12_claims_no_ind, filed_more_than_12_claims_yes_ind, suing_public_entity_no_ind, suing_public_entity_yes_ind

units.name: more_than_two_plaintiffs_ind
units.description: Check here if more than two plaintiffs and attach form SC-100A.

units.name: plaintiff_fictitious_name_ind
units.description: Check here if either plaintiff listed above is doing business under a fictitious name and attach form SC-103.

units.name: plaintiff_is_payday_lender_ind
units.description: Check here if any plaintiff is a “licensee” or “deferred deposit originator” (payday lender) under Financial Code sections 23000 et seq.

units.name: more_than_one_defendant_ind
units.description: Check here if your case is against more than one defendant and attach form SC-100A.

units.name: defendant_active_military_ind
units.description: Check here if any defendant is on active military duty and write defendant’s name here:

units.name: need_more_space_ind
units.description: Check here if you need more space. Attach one sheet of paper or form MC-031 and write “SC-100, Item 3” at the top.

units.name: asked_defendant_yes_ind
units.description: Check if you asked defendant to pay before you sue

units.name: asked_defendant_no_ind
units.description: Check if you did not ask defendant to pay before you sue

units.name: courthouse_reason_a1_ind
units.description: (1) Where the defendant lives or does business. (2) Where the plaintiff’s property was damaged. (3) Where the plaintiff was injured. (4) Where a contract (written or spoken) was made, signed, performed, or broken by the defendant or where the defendant lived or did business when the defendant made the contract.

units.name: courthouse_reason_b_ind
units.description: Where the buyer or lessee signed the contract, lives now, or lived when the contract was made, if this claim, is about an offer or contract for personal, family, or household goods, services, or loans. (Code Civil Procedure, section 395(b).)

units.name: courthouse_reason_c_ind
units.description: Where the buyer signed the contract, lives now, or lived when the contract was made, if this claim is about a retail installment contract (like a credit card). (Civil Code, section 1812.10.)

units.name: courthouse_reason_d_ind
units.description: Where the buyer signed the contract, lives now, or lived when the contract was made, or where the vehicle is permanently garaged, if this claim is about a vehicle finance sale. (Civil Code, section 2984.4.)

units.name: arbitration_sc101_attached_ind
units.description: If yes, and if you have had arbitration, fill out form SC-101, attach it to this form, and check here:
